paragraphs.text: God approves not our life, unless it is reformed according to his word.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: The world esteems them happy who live in wealth and idleness but the Holy Spirit approves them best who live of the mean profit of their labours.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Because God's favour appears in no outward thing more than in the increase of children, he promises to enrich the faithful with this gift.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: children like olive plants round about

paragraphs.text: Because of the spiritual blessing which God has made to his Church, these temporal things will be granted.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For unless God blessed his Church publicly, this private blessing was nothing.
